import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Matrix, Vector

def wood(name, rgb):
    m = bpy.data.materials.get(name) or bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    b = next(n for n in m.node_tree.nodes if n.type == "BSDF_PRINCIPLED")
    b.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (*rgb, 1)
    b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.7
    m.diffuse_color = (*rgb, 1)
    return m

table_mat = wood("Wood_Table", (0.35, 0.18, 0.08))
chair_mat = wood("Wood_Chair", (0.45, 0.25, 0.11))

def build(name, boxes, mat, loc, rot_z=0):
    if name in bpy.data.objects:
        bpy.data.objects.remove(bpy.data.objects[name], do_unlink=True)
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm = bmesh.new()
    for (cx, cy, cz), (sx, sy, sz) in boxes:
        m = Matrix.Translation((cx, cy, cz)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((sx, sy, sz, 1))
        bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=m)
    bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(ob)
    me.materials.append(mat)
    ob.location = loc
    ob.rotation_euler.z = rot_z
    return ob

# Table: 1.6 x 0.9 top at 0.75 high
TW, TD, TH, TT = 1.6, 0.9, 0.75, 0.05
L = 0.07
boxes = [((0, 0, TH - TT/2), (TW, TD, TT))]
for sx in (-1, 1):
    for sy in (-1, 1):
        boxes.append(((sx*(TW/2-0.1), sy*(TD/2-0.1), (TH-TT)/2), (L, L, TH-TT)))
# aprons
boxes.append(((0,  (TD/2-0.1), TH-TT-0.05), (TW-0.2, 0.03, 0.1)))
boxes.append(((0, -(TD/2-0.1), TH-TT-0.05), (TW-0.2, 0.03, 0.1)))
boxes.append((( (TW/2-0.1), 0, TH-TT-0.05), (0.03, TD-0.2, 0.1)))
boxes.append(((-(TW/2-0.1), 0, TH-TT-0.05), (0.03, TD-0.2, 0.1)))
build("Table", boxes, table_mat, (0, 0, 0))

# Chair (local: faces -Y toward table means back at +Y... define back at -Y, front toward +Y)
SW, SH, ST, CL = 0.45, 0.45, 0.04, 0.045
cb = [((0, 0, SH - ST/2), (SW, SW, ST))]
for sx in (-1, 1):
    for sy in (-1, 1):
        h = SH - ST
        cb.append(((sx*(SW/2-CL/2), sy*(SW/2-CL/2), h/2), (CL, CL, h)))
# back posts and slats (back at -Y)
for sx in (-1, 1):
    cb.append(((sx*(SW/2-CL/2), -(SW/2-CL/2), SH + 0.25), (CL, CL, 0.5)))
cb.append(((0, -(SW/2-CL/2), SH + 0.44), (SW, 0.03, 0.1)))
cb.append(((0, -(SW/2-CL/2), SH + 0.25), (SW-2*CL, 0.025, 0.06)))

# Chairs: front faces +Y locally; rotate so front faces table center
gap = 0.25
places = [
    ((0, -(TD/2 + gap + SW/2), 0), 0),               # south, faces +Y
    ((0,  (TD/2 + gap + SW/2), 0), math.pi),         # north
    ((-(TW/2 + gap + SW/2), 0, 0), -math.pi/2),      # west faces +X
    (( (TW/2 + gap + SW/2), 0, 0),  math.pi/2),      # east faces -X
]
for i, (loc, rz) in enumerate(places, 1):
    build(f"Chair {i}", cb, chair_mat, loc, rz)
print("ok")
